title: Seoul shares sharply down late Thu. morning as U.S. midterm results spark AI woes
caption:
South Korean markets saw a sharp decline today as investors reacted to potential changes in U.S. artificial intelligence policy. Tech giants led the downward trend amid election-related uncertainty.
